name: mantle
description: Build and embed Mantle applications. Cold start: npx skills add aotter/mantle --skill install.

interface.longDescription: Cold start with npx skills add aotter/mantle --skill install. Follow that skill to the pinned CLI and handbook, then compose only the modules the host needs.
defaultPrompt: Run npx skills add aotter/mantle --skill install, then follow skills/install/SKILL.md
Follow the Mantle install skill: interview for host and surfaces before writing files
Author a Mantle application from the install skill and an official example
